bridge-type.label: AC Infinity Account
bridge-type.description: Connects to an AC Infinity account and discovers cloud-connected UIS controllers.

parameter.name: email
parameter.label: E-mail
parameter.description: E-mail address registered with the AC Infinity app.

parameter.name: password
parameter.label: Password
parameter.description: Password registered with the AC Infinity app.

parameter.name: refresh
parameter.label: Refresh interval
parameter.description: Cloud polling interval in seconds (minimum 5 seconds).

thing-type.label: AC Infinity Controller
thing-type.description: A Wi-Fi UIS controller discovered through the AC Infinity cloud.

channel-group-type.label: Device Port
channel-group-type.description: A device port (outlet) of the controller.

channel-group-type.label: Sensor Port
channel-group-type.description: A sensor port of an AI controller. Channels stay undefined for readings the attached probe does not provide.

channel-type.label: Online
channel-type.description: Whether the controller is online according to the cloud API.

channel-type.label: Temperature
channel-type.description: Temperature as reported by the cloud API.

channel-type.label: Humidity
channel-type.description: Relative humidity as reported by the cloud API.

channel-type.label: VPD
channel-type.description: Vapor pressure deficit as reported by the cloud API.

channel-type.label: Soil Moisture
channel-type.description: Soil moisture reported by an attached soil probe.

channel-type.label: CO2
channel-type.description: CO2 concentration reported by an attached CO2 probe.

channel-type.label: Light Level
channel-type.description: Light level (percent) reported by an attached light probe.

channel-type.label: pH
channel-type.description: pH value reported by an attached hydroponic probe.

channel-type.label: Water Temperature
channel-type.description: Water temperature reported by an attached hydroponic probe.

channel-type.label: Water Detected
channel-type.description: Whether an attached water sensor detects water.

channel-type.label: Name
channel-type.description: Name of the device attached to the port.

channel-type.label: Connected
channel-type.description: Whether a device is connected to the port.

channel-type.label: Mode
channel-type.description: Current port mode: OFF, ON, AUTO, VPD, or UNKNOWN with the unrecognized API code.

channel-type.label: Load State
channel-type.description: Whether a load is detected on the port. This is distinct from the device connection status.

channel-type.label: Level
channel-type.description: Current speed or power level of the port (0 to 10).

channel-type.label: Remaining Time
channel-type.description: Time remaining until the next mode change of the port.
